programme.title: Avenue of the Giants
programme.desc: California.For years, 74-year-old Herbert Heller hid from his family his traumatic experiences during World War II and his stay in the Auschwitz-Birkenau camp, where he was sent at the age of twelve, and three years later he attempted to escape.All this changes when he meets Abbey (Fisher), rejected by his peers, whose own difficult experiences prompt him to open up.A moving, healing friendship develops between a man and a teenager.The story is based on the true memories of Herbert Heller, a former concentration camp prisoner who settled in the USA after the war.

programme.title: Until Dawn
programme.desc: Clover and her friends go to the valley where her sister disappeared.They become the target of a murderer.Their story repeats itself every morning.

programme.title: Lord Of The Flies
programme.desc: A film adaptation of William Golding's 1954 novel.A group of British boys on a desert island try to create fair rules.However, fear and power struggles lead to chaos and aggression.

programme.title: 4 from there
programme.desc: Another installment of the adventures of people living in a town straight from a nightmare.It is a terrifying place that traps anyone who crosses its borders.Desperate residents fight to stay alive.

programme.title: Bastarden
programme.desc: Year 1755, Denmark.The impoverished Captain Ludvig (Mads Mikkelsen) asks the king for permission to establish a colony on his behalf on the barren moors famous for their infertility.If successful, he expects to be awarded a knighthood and property.The aristocrats are outraged by his arrogance and assume defeat, but he receives consent.From then on, every day for Ludvig and his relatives is spent on hard, physical work beyond their strength, which will allow them to prepare the land for cultivation.They also hire people to help them - two runaway servants: Ann Barbara (Amanda Collin) and her husband.Months pass and the first buildings are built when the ruthless Frederik de Schinkel (Simon Bennebjerg), the land lord, tries to take over the moors.When Ludvig rejects his offer, he decides to destroy it.

programme.title: Freaky
programme.desc: Millie (Kathryn Newton) lives in a small American town and struggles with numerous problems.He can only count on a pair of loyal friends, Josh (Misha Osherovich) and Nyla (Celeste O'Connor).She is ridiculed by her peers and has just lost her father.To make matters worse, he becomes the target of a psychopath roaming the area, the Blissfield Butcher (Vince Vaughn).The bloody incident has surprising consequences - the girl, stabbed with an antique dagger on a moonlit night, magically switches bodies with her tormentor.In the morning he wakes up as a wanted murderer, and the Butcher can now go hunting in the form of a delicate blonde.Millie has only 24 hours to reverse the spell.Christopher Landon, the creator of "Die Another Day", pays tribute to the classics of horror cinema.He skillfully plays with convention, referring to "Halloween" or "Scream".

programme.title: By sleeping with others
programme.desc: Lainey and Jake had only slept together once, but it was the first and most important time in their lives.But then the lovers parted ways.A few years later, they accidentally bump into each other...

programme.title: Legend of the Boneknapper Dragon
programme.desc: Gobber is convinced that the legendary dragon Gnatochrup is behind the burning of his house.When none of the neighbors want to believe in the existence of the beast, the old Viking decides to hunt the dragon that is stalking him.He is joined by Hiccup and friends to ensure Gobber's safe return.During the sea journey, they listen to more and more unbelievable stories about the rivalry between a Viking and a monster.Eventually, the travelers crash on Dragon Island, where they learn the truth about Gnatochrup.The animation is a continuation of the film "How to Train Your Dragon".In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Tomasz Traczyński, Mateusz Narloch, Grzegorz Drojewski and Julia Kamińska.

programme.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: The situation of the mutant monkeys changes with the appearance of a formation led by the Colonel, which seeks to take control of the apes.Meanwhile, Blue Eyes informs his father that he has found a place for their tribe to live.The decision is made to march.Under the cover of darkness, an attack occurs.Caesar's son and wife are killed.Despite the tragedy, the primate leader believes in the success of a peaceful solution.On his own, he searches for the person responsible for the massacre, but falls into the hands of the enemy.He then finds out that his compatriots were forced to work as slaves.People are attacked by a virus that reverses the process of evolution.The final showdown is inevitably approaching.

programme.title: La grazia
programme.desc: The President of Italy (Toni Servillo) is at the end of his term.In six months, his political and social role will come to an end.At this time, the head of state faces moral dilemmas caused by the euthanasia regulations and the issue of pardoning two life sentences.Every decision will expose the politician to criticism, but it is up to him to decide which crime deserves forgiveness: an act of mercy or murder.Bending under the weight of responsibility, the statesman tries to buy time.At the same time, he struggles with personal problems.Despite the passage of 40 years, he still has not forgiven his deceased wife's betrayal, and he cannot find the way to his daughter (Anna Ferzetti).Ultimately, however, it proves that even if you know yourself perfectly, you can make a decision that will surprise everyone and bring inner freedom.

programme.title: The Other Guys
programme.desc: Hot-tempered New York detective Terry Hoitz (Mark Wahlberg) dreams of his name going down in police history.Unfortunately, he is punitively delegated to office work.His dim-witted partner Allen Gamble (Will Ferrell) is not keen on catching criminals and would rather spend his days behind a desk.As a result, those with completely opposite characters do not like each other.However, both of them share a feeling of inferiority because they are still in the shadow of the local police celebrities: P.K.Highsmith (Samuel L. Jackson) and Christopher Danson (Dwayne Johnson).The opportunity to take their place comes sooner than they might expect.When the famous duo is killed in action, Terry and Allen face the opportunity of a lifetime.They are on the trail of a scandal involving multimillionaire David Ershon (Steve Coogan).If they manage to find evidence of a crime and catch the culprits, they will gain recognition and decorations.However, if they fail, they will face professional degradation.

programme.title: Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The supporting penguin agents known from the three parts of "Madagascar" return to the cinema screen in their own production.Great entertainment for younger and older viewers guaranteed.Skipper, Kowalski, Rico and Private engage in a mission on which the fate of the world depends.They must face the geneticist Oktawiusz Mackiewicz, who dreams of controlling the Earth.In fact, the enemy of flightless birds is a vengeful octopus.It intends to settle accounts with visitors from Antarctica.Penguin agents join forces with the secret organization North Wind, which includes: the Greenland seal Detonator, the muscular teddy bear Kapral and the snowy owl Ewa.They are commanded by the mysterious Arctic Wolf, the Covert Agent.Good company awakens the competitive spirit in Skipper.As befits real superspies, the flightless unit travels halfway around the world.He visits, among others:Venice, Antarctica, Shanghai and New York.

programme.title: The Martian
programme.desc: A mission to the Red Planet is interrupted by a sandstorm.A team of astronauts evacuates to Earth, leaving one of the expedition members, Mark Watney (Matt Damon), on the surface of Mars, believing he is dead.After some time, the seriously injured astronaut regains consciousness.He realizes that his air and food supplies will soon be exhausted.He also cannot count on a rescue mission because he was presumed dead.Despite this, he tries to survive in difficult conditions and notify the inhabitants of Earth that he is alive and waiting for help.Ridley Scott's film is nominated for an Oscar in seven categories, including:as the best film and for the leading role of Matt Damon.Director Ridley Scott, the creator of such cult sci-fi films as "Blade Runner" and the Alien series, was a candidate for the Academy Award four times.

programme.title: Kingdom of Heaven
programme.desc: 12th century.The young blacksmith Balian (Orlando Bloom) loses his entire family in tragic circumstances.He begins to doubt the existence of God.Then he is visited by the crusader Godfrey of Ibelin (Liam Neeson), who turns out to be his father.He suggests his son learn knightly crafts.One day, Balian kills a priest in a fight.He must escape.Together with Godfrey, he sets off for Jerusalem.On the way, his father is killed by the bishop's men.Prudent King Baldwin IV (Edward Norton) and his advisor Tiberias (Jeremy Irons) strive for a peaceful solution.Thanks to them, there are no hostilities in Jerusalem.They even manage to reach a truce with the leader of the Muslims, Saladin (Ghassan Massoud).However, the ruler's conciliatory policy does not please some greedy and fanatical crusaders.Meanwhile, Balian falls in love with the king's sister, the already married princess Sibyl (Eva Green).The girl does not love her husband, Baron Guy de Lusignan (Marton Csokas).Soon the Crusaders start a war with the Muslims.

programme.title: Final Destination: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Student Stefani (Kaitlyn Santa Juana) is plagued by nightmares about her grandparents.In their dreams, they die along with other people in the Skyview skyscraper in 1969.Although such an event never happened, the girl decides to investigate the cause of her visions.To do this, he returns to his hometown, Cloverdale.She is greeted there by her father, Marty (Tinpo Lee), and younger brother, Charlie (Teo Briones).Stefani begins searching for Iris (Brec Bassinger), the grandmother she sees in her nightmares and who has broken off contact with her family.To do this, he visits his Uncle Howard (Alex Zahara) and Aunt Brenda (April Telek).Thanks to the letters found among them, he reaches a woman (Gabrielle Rose) who is dying of cancer and lives in a remote area.She tells her that the skyscraper did not collapse only thanks to her vision and earlier intervention.At the same time, he warns that from that day on, death has haunted everyone who died in the disaster, and even the descendants of the would-be victims.As she dies, her words quickly come true.Stefani wants to save her relatives from the gruesome death that inevitably awaits them.The sixth installment of the series launched in 2000.

programme.title: Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Yorkshire.Catherine Earnshaw (Margot Robbie) begins a love relationship with the stray Heathcliff (Jacob Elordi), taken in by her father.The forbidden feeling has a destructive effect on both of them.

programme.title: Hail Mary
programme.desc: Popular writer Maria (Laura Weissmahr) has recently become a mother.Her days are filled with caring for her son and visiting doctors.There is virtually no time left to create.To make matters worse, the husband keeps postponing the promised paternity leave and ignores the difficulties his wife is facing.At this time, Barcelona is shaken by information about the crime committed by a young French woman who drowned her 10-month-old twins in the bathtub.Maria follows this case with increasing attention, which slowly becomes her obsession.

programme.title: Happy Feet
programme.desc: Antarctica.Mambo was born in a land famous for penguins with vocal talent.Singing gives them a sense of community and cements relationships.Unfortunately, Mambo does not have this ability.His mother Norma Jean sees nothing wrong with it, but Memphis' father fears for the future of his son who, due to his inability, may never find his soul mate.The penguin has another valuable gift - he can tap dance perfectly.However, this is not enough for his friend Gloria, the best singer in the area and the leader of the Penguin Empire, who banishes Mamba.He thinks that he doesn't fit in with the rest of the herd.While traveling alone, the exile encounters alien penguins.They are delighted with his tap dancing ability and invite him to their land.There, the penguin discovers a very important truth in life, which says that being yourself is the most important thing.An excellent family film, awarded with an Oscar and a Golden Globe.

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
programme.desc: Orphaned Harry Potter is raised by his Uncle Vernon and Aunt Petunia.His guardians don't care about him, and his cousin Dudley constantly teases him.One day, a mysterious letter arrives to Harry.His relatives do not allow him to read it because it reveals the secret of his origins.However, on his eleventh birthday, the boy learns the truth.It turns out that he is the son of a pair of magicians who were killed by the wizard Voldemort.To his surprise, Harry also discovers that he has inherited extraordinary abilities from his parents.He receives an invitation to study at Hogwarts, the school of magic.His life changes completely.Once there, Harry is surprised to discover that he is famous in the wizarding community.At school, he makes friends with his peers, Ron and Hermione.Together with them, he tries to discover the secret of the philosopher's stone hidden within the walls of the academy.They experience many adventures together.Potter must face the enemy who contributed to the death of his loved ones.

programme.title: Doc Ii.
programme.desc: Dr. Amy Larsen, former chief of internal medicine, is rebuilding her life after a tragic accident that left her with no memory.Now she is an intern.Her past still haunts me.

programme.title: Big Fish
programme.desc: Edward Bloom (Albert Finney), a brilliant storyteller and favorite of the neighborhood, is dying.His son Will (Billy Crudup) left home long ago, not wanting to live forever in the shadow of his father's fantastic stories.Now she returns to accompany him in his last moments.Listening to Edward's stories again, Will tries to put them together to make sense.The picture that emerges is surprisingly coherent and shows the father's life in a new light.The son realizes who his father really was.Tim Burton, one of the most eccentric creators of American cinema, created a film that captivates with its warmth, fairy-tale atmosphere and surreal poetics.The script is based on the novel "Big Fish: A Story of Mythic Proportions" by Daniel Wallace.We will see Ewan McGregor as young Edward.The atmospheric music received an Oscar nomination.

programme.title: Eine Million Minuten
programme.desc: Spouses Vera (Karoline Herfurth) and Wolf (Tom Schilling) Küper, parents of Nina (Pola Friedrichs) and Simon (Piet Levi Busch), have difficulty dividing their time between work and household duties.The bond that united them years ago is weakening.Wolf focuses on his professional career, and Vera, confined to her four walls, is fed up with loneliness and having to replace her children's fathers.The family's world is ruined by the daughter's disastrous medical diagnosis.Wolf recalls that the girl's greatest wish was to spend a million minutes solely on pleasure.The Küpers decide to make her dream come true.Together they set off on a lifelong journey that leads through exotic regions of the world.They get to know new places and foreign cultures, and decide what their future will look like.

programme.title: The Idea of You
programme.desc: Solene (Anne Hathaway) is the owner of an art gallery.One day, a divorced woman accompanies her daughter to a concert and meets her musical idol - the singer of the boy band Hayes Campbell (Nicholas Galitzine), about whom teenagers fantasize.Despite the significant age difference, they both feel that they have a lot in common.They start an affair.Paparazzi make their romantic moments miserable.The revelation of a young musician's relationship with a middle-aged single mother turns out to be a media sensation.An unusual love story with a script based on the novel by Robinne Lee.
